name: Tsukinari Ema
source:
A girl who attends the school where the protagonist teaches. An honor student gifted with beauty and intelligence, who is accomplished in both literary and martial arts (archery).

Her grandfather is well known in their hometown, but she carries a trauma involving her parents. 

A beautiful girl known for her long black hair and white skin who has an air of nobility around her. 

Her beauty and high class status made her classmates shy away from her, but in actuality, she wants to be friends with them too.

[Translated from [url=http://pachi2.com/migawari/#character]Official Site[/url]]
